text:
Maria L: @channel escalation from ZenithApp — they're seeing intermittent 429 throttles + tail-latency spikes on their dedicated pool during the campaign. Pool ID: pool-zenith-3
Devon (SRE): Can you paste the error snippets and approximate peak QPS? 429s could be autoscaler not reacting or request-level throttling.
Maria L: Logs from customer: ``"error": "rate_limited", "detail": "burst tokens exhausted"``. They report baseline ~180 qps, peaks up to ~950 qps sustained for ~3–5m bursts. They've got reserved pool with 3 GPUs.
Samir (Support): Thanks — that baseline:peak ratio is high. With 3 GPUs we're hitting token-generation saturation. Do we have recent telemetry on GPU utilization for pool-zenith-3?
autoscale-bot: metric snapshot: pool-zenith-3 | gpu_util: [avg: 78%, p95: 99%] | inflight_reqs: [avg: 22, p95: 110] | active_instances: 3 → 3 (no scale event in last 30m)
Devon (SRE): autoscaler logs show: ``scale_decision: desired_replicas=3, observed_util=82, threshold=85, cooldown=300s`` — looks like threshold is 85% and cooldown is 5m, so short bursts might not trigger a scale up.
Jess (ProdEng): Also seeing many long-tail token loops from their payloads. Small percentage of requests hold GPU for >4s which pushes p95 up. We might be seeing noisy neighbor + insufficient headroom.
Alex P: Customer's model is a 13B variant with KV cache and long context. Per-request token counts spike during campaign (avg gen tokens from 64 → 420). That explains sustained GPU occupancy.
Maria L: Repro steps I gave them (works from our side):

curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"zenith-13b","prompt":"<large-promo-payload>","max_tokens":420}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq .

They hit 429s reproducible when firing ~700 qps with similar payload shape.
Devon (SRE): Immediate mitigations:
- Lower autoscale threshold to 70% for pool-zenith-3 to pick up bursts earlier.
- Decrease cooldown to 120s for burst-prone pools.
- Add request-level ingress rate-limiter for tenant to smooth spikes (token bucket with burst_window=30s)
Jess (ProdEng): Medium term: recommend moving Zenith to a larger instance profile (4 GPUs) or add a warm standby replica pool that can accept overflow. Also add per-model concurrency limits.
Samir (Support): Also flag billing: customer saw unexpected surge billing due to retry behavior during 429s. We should offer credit for the campaign window while we remediate.
Alex P: I can prepare a suggested autoscale config:
``
min_replicas: 3
max_replicas: 8
scale_target_gpu_utilization: 0.7
cooldown_seconds: 120
burst_headroom_replicas: 2
```
Devon (SRE): I'll validate autoscaler logs + simulator. Action items:
- Devon: test new autoscale config in staging and run synthetic burst test (owner)
- Jess: check model fragmentation/kv cache eviction causing long tails (owner)
- Samir: coordinate customer comms and credits (owner)
- Maria L: create postmortem-ish note and schedule follow-up call with Zenith ops for tomorrow
Maria L: @Devon please include exact log snippets and timestamps so we can share to Zenith for transparency.
Devon (SRE): Will do. Initial autoscaler test result (staging): simulated 1k qps 30s bursts scaled 3→6 in 95s, p95 latency reduced from 1.6s → 0.9s. Uploading logs to https://console.redwood.ai/pools/pool-zenith-3/logs?from=1767554321
autoscale-bot: executed config change proposal (dry-run) for pool-zenith-3: new_threshold=70, cooldown=120
Samir (Support): I'll draft the customer message: we'll propose temporary quota bump + credit, and recommend moving to 4-gpu plan if they expect sustained peaks >700 qps. Also ask for a sample of payload mix to run evals.
Maria L: Good. One more note: set utilization target to 60–70% not >80% for tenant-dedicated pools that have unpredictable marketing bursts.
Jess (ProdEng): Also adding per-tenant KV cache pinning for their hot prompts will avoid cross-tenant eviction.
Alex P: FYI we should monitor model quantization - moving to int8 might save ~30% GPU seconds for this model.
Samir (Support): Customer-facing timeline: apply autoscale threshold change (now-dry-run) → staging test pass → roll to prod in 2 hours → monitor for 6h. I'll propose credits once prod change confirms improvement.
Maria L: Thanks team. I'll update the Zen ticket with action items and ping once Devon posts logs. :thumbsup:
Devon (SRE): Posting autoscaler trace excerpt:
```
[1767554390] scale_evaluator: observed_util=0.82, window=60s, predicted_load=1.3x
[1767554455] scale_action: increase_to=5, reason="predicted sustained burst"
[1767554510] scale_action: applied, new_replicas=5
```
Maria L: Closing loop: Zenith confirmed fewer 429s after the prod roll for 2 hours of monitoring, but we'll keep 24h watch.
Samir (Support): I'll keep the customer updated. Closing the thread after 24h if stable.
